facts.fact: The government portal reports that under the Stratégie nationale Togo Digital 2025 181 classrooms were connected through the ENT, reaching 8,500 pupils, and over 1,000 computers, printers and projectors were installed in scientific secondary schools, run jointly by the education and digital transformation ministries; counts of activity, measured against no target of the strategy, and dated by the article's publication date, 2026-05-04, as the document gives no event date.

systems.owner: Ministries of Education and Digital Transformation
